name: Giriş — yanlış şifre Türkçe hata mesajı gösterir

planSteps.description: Type 'testsprite-nouser@example.com' into the email input and 'yanlisSifre123' into the password input
Click the 'Giriş Yap' button and wait up to 10 seconds for the server response
The inline error element below the password field shows exactly the text 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı.'
The submit button text is back to 'Giriş Yap' and the button is enabled again (not stuck on 'Lütfen bekle...')
The login form is still visible; the stat card 'Toplam Ürün' is not visible
